name: QWEN-HOMEO-ACTUATOR-0
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-HOMEO-ACTUATOR-0 (RESULTS, 2026-08-20), transcribed alongside the RESULTS registration, before any run. Frozen sidecar shas, detector/window/cap constants, and arm build recipe in qwen-homeo-actuator-0.params.json. Runs only on explicit Artin 3080 GO. ALWAYS-HIGH (BLem free generation from token 0) is OPTIONAL descriptive color only — outside every bar and the refutation predicate.

REFRESH-LOW.description: sanity gate exercising the treatment reconstruction path: teacher-force the frozen LOW prefix [0,event) through BLe to reconstruct S_BLe(prefix_LOW), then free greedy continuation to cap; continuation must reproduce the frozen sidecar tokens exactly, 3/3 items

HOT-HIGH.description: BLe replay to the frozen event position, tower weights swapped to BLem retaining cached/recurrent state (F(W_BLem, S^BLe)), continue to eos/cap

REFRESH-HIGH.description: same-prefix refresh per the bank: teacher-force the frozen LOW prefix [0,event) through BLem to reconstruct S_BLem(prefix_LOW), then free greedy continuation from the event to eos/cap

bars.name: GATE-S-SANITY
bars.description: REFRESH-LOW reproduces the frozen trajectory token-identically 3/3; any miss books INSTRUMENT-INVALID and no treatment cell is adjudicated

bars.name: HOT-AUTHORITY
bars.description: >= 2 of 3 HOT-HIGH branches escape (no frozen-detector fire within the 300-token post-switch window)

bars.name: REFRESH-AUTHORITY
bars.description: >= 2 of 3 REFRESH-HIGH branches escape (no frozen-detector fire within the 300-token post-event window — identical criterion to bar 2)

bars.name: ANY-AUTHORITY
bars.description: qualification floor: at least 1 of the 6 high-arm branches escapes (300-token post-event window, both high arms)

bars.name: REPAIR
bars.description: >= 1 high-arm branch ends with a correct final answer (sympy oracle, independent offline consumer authoritative)

refuted_if: bar 4 counts zero: six high-arm branches, zero escapes under the 300-token post-event criterion — the one-band precision escalation has no measurable authority at these events; the precision actuator demotes at this dose and the controller stage does not launch on it. Adjudicated only if bar 1 (sanity) fires, per refutation_precedence.
registered_prior: bar 1 (sanity) passes; bar 2 NO-FIRE at 0/3 (mixed-state continuation, modest dose); bar 3 NO-FIRE at 1/3; bar 4 FIRES via a REFRESH branch (1-2 of 6); bar 5 NO-FIRE at 0/6. Rationale: rigid-orbit perturbations all reconverged (CYCLE 0/192 exact-orbit bursts, HEADSWAP-IMPULSE 0/5 informed tokens) but CYCLE's semantic-restart item escaped at 5/18 — escape is not unprecedented, it is item-class-dependent; a consistent higher-fidelity state is the house's best candidate for reaching it. Informative outcomes: any HOT escape (cheap actuator exists) or a bar-4 zero (refutation)
